images.name: fml
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind, drives away; in the rear-view mirror two small children, a girl in sunglasses and a smiling boy, look back at him. Speech bubble: "FML - what am I doing?"

images.name: are-you-quitting-bike-racing
images.alt: Several hands push microphones toward cartoon Gravel God, shown in profile, eyebrows up; a speech bubble from the reporters asks: "Are you quitting bike racing?"

images.name: da-fugg
images.joke: Da fugg? Nice facial hair loser.
images.alt: Two panels. "2010": a photo of a young, clean-shaven Matti in a grey T-shirt with orange sunglasses pushed up on his forehead, in a kitchen. "2021": cartoon Gravel God, handlebar mustache, arms crossed, eyeing the photo, with a speech bubble: "Da fugg? Nice facial hair loser."

images.name: makes-sense
images.joke: One thing I realize is that I don't like spending prolonged stretches away from my family, especially when the best-case scenario is that I'll get my shit kicked in. Makes sense.
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands on a gravel road at sunset, arms crossed and thinking, with a thought bubble: "One thing I realize is that I don't like spending prolonged stretches away from my family, especially when the best-case scenario is that I'll get my shit kicked in. Makes sense."
images.note: No hand-on-chin gesture: arms crossed with a thinking face.

images.name: train-your-heart
images.alt: A close-up of cartoon Gravel God smiling at the left, beside a photo of two small children, a boy and a girl, walking away hand in hand.
images.note: The rig face can't sit faded behind the photo; he is beside the children instead of under them.
